scope: Captured shared search loader, client request contract, resolver handling and declared query schemas; original TypeScript and backend implementation remain unknown

loader.chunkUrlResolution: Literal _next-relative chunk names matched to retained authenticated pump.fun asset URLs; runtime global base-path overrides are not executed or qualified

queryEncoding.array: String(item), reject commas, join with comma
queryEncoding.emptyArray: omit only when the named query field accepts undefined; otherwise throw TypeError
queryEncoding.validation: the client does not parse nonempty query values with the declared query schema

responseHandling.degraded: not consumed by this resolver helper

identifiers.description: Comma-separated identifiers (repeated and mixed forms parse identically): a coin address (mint, bonding curve or pool), a Solana wallet, an EVM address, a TON token address, a NEAR or Starknet token address (while coin cards for that chain are served; a 0x plus 40-hex address is always EVM), or a pump.fun user id

offset.description: Default 0, max 2147483647 (int32); a deeper offset is refused with 400

searchTerm.description: 66 admits a whole Starknet address paste (0x + 64 hex) and 64 a whole NEAR account paste; a raw (untrimmed) term over 50 (search-service's own hard limit) is a 400 unless its trimmed value is a NEAR account paste (dotted or 64-hex) over 50 while NEAR cards are live, or a Starknet address paste while Starknet cards are live

deviceId.description: Persisted install/device id, forwarded verbatim to search-service, which buckets the device-grain search-ranking experiment on it

minVolumeSol.description: No-op: not forwarded to the search backend.

maxVolumeSol.description: No-op: not forwarded to the search backend.

maxLastTradeAgeSeconds.description: Upper bound on the age of the last trade in seconds; a never-traded coin never passes

quoteMints.description: Include filter on the coin launch quote mint, at most 32: base58 SVM mint or 0x EVM address; SOL is always spelled as wSOL So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112 on the index (other SOL spellings are folded to it)

excludeQuoteMints.description: Exclude filter on the coin launch quote mint, at most 32: base58 SVM mint or 0x EVM address; SOL is always spelled as wSOL So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112 on the index (other SOL spellings are folded to it)

activeViewerCount.description: Max 2147483647 (int32); a larger value is refused with 400

launchpadOnly.description: Only launchpad-born coins: program in the registry launchpadPrograms set, applied by search-service; an absent program counts as pump on SVM only

maxDepth.description: Pump curve depth ceiling (inclusive), max 4294967295 (uint32); coins created before the depth rung count as 0. The coin-creation picker sends program=pump&pumpSwapGraduatedOnly=true&maxDepth=<max_curve_depth-1>.

pumpSwapGraduatedOnly.description: Only coins launched on Pump and migrated to PumpSwap (pump_swap_pool set, no raydium_pool).

includeFollowedHolders.description: Opt-in: attach the followed-holders facepile per coin (needs a viewer JWT; anonymous opt-in gets followed_holders: null). Off by default.

followedHoldersLimit.description: Followed holders returned per coin (default 3; values above 10 clamp to 10).

limit.description: Rows per page, default 5. search-service caps the 7-day recency-filtered page at 50; larger values are accepted and clamped to 50, not rejected.

includePerps.description: true appends up to 5 HyperCore perp rows after the slate on offset 0; absent or false never appends. Default false.

offset.description: Default 0, max 2147483647 (int32); a deeper offset is refused with 400

resolver GET query and abort signal

limits: Chunk provenance demonstrates a static loading chain, not execution or complete route reachability.
The small adapter does not reproduce Ky retries, ContractError wrapping, cache behavior, coin normalization, full hook lifecycle, backend responses or auth enforcement.
The captured website origin and cookie options do not establish that the developer API origin uses the same authentication.
No API, feature-progress or live compatibility milestone is awarded.
